title: Dinotopia Teaching Unit
content: Tony Shaw, who presides at aone-teacher schoolin the bush of Australia, has created a teacher's resource usingDinotopia: Journey to Chandarain the classroom.He put together afree downloadable documentto give fellow teachers ideas on how they might use the illustrated book in their curriculum."The great thing about working with literature such as yours is that you always find new ideas, approaches and messages to explore with your students. I will be teaching this unit next term and I expect I will come up with additional ideas as I go along."Thanks, Tony!Link to Glen Park School page--click on "Dinotopia" to download PDFOrder a signed copy of the original Dinotopia book for your classroomTony's unit is based on the 2007 book Dinotopia: Journey to Chandara
